languagePolicy: Internal text strings inside each render* function are hard-coded in English and MUST NOT be translated or rewritten by the skill. Default lang attribute on output HTML must be "en".
notes: 每个模块对应 script.js 里的一个 render* 函数。id 用 kebab-case。editableProps 采用字段级白名单，不在白名单内的字符串一律锁定。

editableProps.name: periods
editableProps.notes: Exactly 3 phases. Only the 3 date spans are editable; phase labels are locked.

modules.name: 奖品区
modules.purpose: 奖项列表 + 奖品卡片 + 展开折叠

editableProps.name: prizes
editableProps.notes: Editable list content and count. When count > 7, generator must auto-collapse overflow and keep See more behavior. Reward art should first resolve from configured assets by reward name + region/country.

editableProps.name: items
editableProps.notes: Full rule lines editable. #hashtag tokens should be auto-highlighted.

modules.name: Campaign 任务
modules.purpose: Campaign 玩法专属任务列表

editableProps.name: highlightAmount
editableProps.notes: Only the red amount inside 'UP TO ... USD PRIZES !' is editable.

editableProps.name: tierRewards
editableProps.notes: Reward cards support editable count and reward content.

editableProps.name: milestones
editableProps.notes: Milestone count and thresholds are editable.

editableProps.name: tasks
editableProps.notes: Task copy is editable. Task type must come from a fixed enum, and button behavior/text should derive from that enum.

modules.name: Collect 玩法分发
modules.purpose: 根据 variant 路由到 collect-* 子模块

modules.name: Collect-富展示
modules.purpose: 复杂收集型展示，含解锁/锁定状态

editableProps.name: videoIds
editableProps.notes: video-card articles should be hydrated from a business video API by video IDs, not hand-written static mock text.

editableProps.name: banners
editableProps.notes: Only banner asset and click target are editable.

modules.name: 作品审核区
modules.purpose: CRP 类活动的审核状态展示

shellModules.name: 页面外壳
shellModules.purpose: 导航栏 + 内容容器，不可单独使用，由 script.js 自动包裹

shellModules.name: 顶部导航
shellModules.purpose: 标题 + 返回按钮，由 shell 调用

shellModules.name: 状态栏
shellModules.purpose: iOS 状态栏拟物，由 shell 调用

rules.doNotTranslate: Skill MUST NOT translate any built-in English string that is not explicitly opened in editableProps.
rules.doNotRewriteAsCustom: Skill MUST NOT rewrite a built-in module as a custom-* module to bypass field-level editableProps limits.
